$comment: Foreign qualification package — generated whenever the operating state differs from the formation state.

clauses.title: Application for Authority
clauses.rationale: Transacting business without qualifying typically means back fees, penalties, and no access to that state's courts until cured.
clauses.body: {{company}}, a {{formStateLong}} {{entityLong}}, applies for authority to transact business in {{opStateLong}} and designates the Secretary of State of {{opStateLong}} as its agent for service of process in any action arising out of business transacted in that state.

clauses.title: In-State Registered Agent
clauses.rationale: The qualifying state requires its own agent. The formation-state agent named in the charter does not carry over.
clauses.body: The Company shall appoint and continuously maintain a registered agent with a physical address in {{opStateLong}}. This is separate from the {{formStateLong}} agent named in <<xr:charter_agent>>; both must be maintained.

clauses.title: Name Availability and Assumed Name
clauses.rationale: A name available in the formation state may be taken in the operating state, in which case the company must qualify under an assumed name.
clauses.body: If {{company}} is not available in {{opStateLong}}, the Company shall adopt and register an assumed or fictitious name for use in that state, and shall use that name consistently in contracts and filings made there.

clauses.title: Certificate of Good Standing
clauses.rationale: Most states reject an application supported by a stale certificate, and the rejection restarts the clock.
clauses.body: A certificate of [[good standing]] from {{formStateLong}} dated within the preceding sixty (60) days must accompany this application. Order it before filing rather than after, and confirm the receiving state’s specific recency requirement.

clauses.title: State Tax and Employer Registration
clauses.rationale: Qualification with the Secretary of State is not the same as registering with the revenue and labor agencies. Companies routinely do the first and forget the second.
clauses.body: Separately from this application, the Company shall register with the {{opStateLong}} revenue agency for applicable sales, use, and income tax accounts, and — if it will have employees in that state — for unemployment insurance and withholding, as calendared in <<xr:cal_foreign>>.
